```sql
WITH region_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Grove City' AND border_type ILIKE 'city'
),
clipped_raster AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Clip(r.rast, 1, rg.geom, TRUE) AS clipped_rast
  FROM
    public.dem_us r,
    region_geom rg
  WHERE
    ST_Intersects(r.rast::geometry, rg.geom)
),
elevation_stats AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(ST_Value(clipped_rast, 1)) AS max_elevation,
    MIN(ST_Value(clipped_rast, 1)) AS min_elevation
  FROM
    clipped_raster
)
SELECT
  max_elevation - min_elevation AS elevation_difference
FROM
  elevation_stats;
```
